Noted on the minds 0.4.0 wire-compat snapshot that it also covers the minds 0.4.3 release, and extended its `SUPPORT_ENDS` to 2026-09-29 (0.4.3's release date plus the support window). The strictly-parsed connector response surface is unchanged between minds-v0.4.2 and minds-v0.4.3: the only `wire_types` changes are field descriptions and the additive optional `SyncWorkspaceRecord.backup_bucket` field (default `None`), which adds no required field, and no new strict-parse call sites were added client-side. No new snapshot module is needed, and nothing was pruned (the 0.3.16 and 0.4.0 snapshots are both still in-window).
